note: Set B captures the key behavioral facts from the prose — the Flexinol wire contracts on heating to rotate the idler pulley, Kevlar strings transfer that rotation to the pulleys, and added strain lowers the transition temperature — all correctly bound with their conditions, whereas Set A omits these entirely and offers only the 15–30 C range (itself quoted as "transition temperature" rather than the text's "transformation temperature range"). Both sets pad heavily with trivial diagram-label component claims and duplicates, but A has more of them (about 16 versus 12). B's defects are quote-fidelity slips ("rotates a assembly", "cutting of each of the 250 louvers") and one misbound condition (32 rods tagged "final assembly" rather than the pulley assembly), while B's only important omission is the 15–30 C transformation range that A does state.
